tasks.label: build tetris v4
tasks.command: call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64 && cl.exe /EHsc /Zi /MDd /std:c++17 /I "${workspaceFolder}\SFML\include" main.cpp functionality.cpp /link /LIBPATH:"${workspaceFolder}\SFML\lib" sfml-graphics-d.lib sfml-window-d.lib sfml-system-d.lib /OUT:tetris_game.exe
